user.title: Configure OPPO Cloud Tracker
user.description: Enter your Remote Browser URL and OPPO account credentials.

sms_code.title: SMS Verification
sms_code.description: OPPO Cloud sent a code to {masked_phone}. Enter the 6-digit code from the SMS.

manual_verify.title: Security verification required
manual_verify.description: OPPO Cloud requires an interactive {verification_type} verification (e.g. drag the slider). Open the browser view at {novnc_url}, complete the verification **manually**, then submit. The integration never solves the CAPTCHA automatically; the verified session is saved and reused.

data.confirm: I completed the verification in the browser view

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate OPPO Cloud Tracker
reauth_confirm.description: Your OPPO credentials have expired or are invalid. Please enter your updated credentials for account: {username}

error.connection: Unable to connect to Remote Browser {error_detail}
error.sms_code: Incorrect or expired SMS code, please retry.
error.verification_pending: Verification not finished yet — drag the slider / complete the graphic challenge in the browser view, then submit again.
error.wrong_account: The username does not match the existing account. Please use the same account or remove and re-add the integration.

abort.already_configured: This OPPO account is already configured.

init.title: Configure Options
init.description: Configure additional options for OPPO Cloud Tracker

data.scan_interval: Scan interval (seconds, 30-3600) Be careful with power consumption!

locate.name: Locate Devices
locate.description: Trigger an immediate update of device locations from OPPO Cloud.

resume_verification.name: Resume after manual verification
resume_verification.description: Call after completing the slider/graphic verification in the Selenium browser view (noVNC) to poll the preserved session and continue login immediately.
